test_fetch_openml_as_frame_true: test fetch_openml with as_frame=True to return pandas DataFrames for data and target
test_fetch_openml_as_frame_false: test fetch_openml with as_frame=False to return numpy arrays for data and target
test_fetch_openml_consistency_parser: test consistency between liac-arff and pandas parsers for fetch_openml
test_fetch_openml_types_inference: test fetch_openml correctly infers number of categories, floats, and integers from ARFF datasets
test_fetch_openml_error: test fetch_openml raises appropriate errors for invalid target columns, string attributes, and missing parameters
